Child of #1202: the next bounded source-fitness batch from actually merged global routing #1298 / PR #1307 at `0198938719a5666b6726fb6a1e45779926eefeb2`. This is one nine-family source-product batch, not 28 separate issues and not correction approval.

The exact scope is nine complete recorded `gb:JPN:ADM2` families containing 28 whole components and 21 complete recorded Atlas contacts. All nine families have no numeric-first members. Preserve all dispositions: 11 land-plus-compatible-original-source observations, 10 partial/unbound land cases, three mixed-support cases and four outside-source-domain cases. Native-source compatibility is a starting observation, not proof of source fitness, authority, current physical truth, historical cause or repair permission. Coastline, island, harbor and water contexts require full candidate-scale applicability; source absence cannot be classified as land or water.

Immutable inputs and scope:
- Delivered report SHA `2bf401f76aabc30cb9f0120aba958545146ebf37e304d8817d15eed800fa5265` and input configuration SHA `7623fa8a61b72c33a1560f0ab612e70c463e8c25beef930043c985fd6657f173` at the actual merge above. Restore complete ordered gzip byte slices and authenticate concatenated whole raw bodies before UTF8/JSON parsing. The audited current geography is the existing immutable `c6a26e1caba54e1b81a89fbda3a64fff56da323d` cohort, not evolving later main.
- Main authenticated the complete delivered component/family bodies (95,173 and 15,610 rows), all 28 full candidate features against routed whole-feature/geometry hashes, exact complete family membership/no numeric members, and all 21 full Atlas contact features against all 36 world parts / 49,625 rows. Contacts occur in complete `data/geography/part-11.json` and `data/geography/part-12.json` bodies. Full candidates and their source/context aliases remain mandatory, not centroid/bbox/hash-only substitutes.
- Original recorded geoBoundaries Japan ADM2 metadata gives reference year 2017 and `scripts/administrative.py` / retained historical source commit leads. Authenticate actual complete originals, original/full versus simplified products, CRS, axis order, identity, source role, dates and reuse terms independently. Reuse existing accepted full-source custody/comparison evidence; do not recompute a world detector or canonical grid. A replacement product is a separate vintage, never silently the historical source. Research official GSI/MLIT/responsible municipality primary sources where finite applicability can be demonstrated; no source is approved by this issue.

Acceptance:
1. Deliver complete identity/input/scope/provenance/uncertainty bindings for every28wholecandidate, all9wholefamilies and21completecontacts. Preserve every original pointset/ring/member/context, original/current source/candidate distinction, recipes, counts, IDs, source-year and observed physical/admin statuses. Verify exact union, no duplicates/foreign IDs, no numeric-first insertion and fullfamily closure. If actual scope differs from this retained delivery, document the difference and stop before silently rebinding it.
2. Independently assess original source product purpose, geometric role, native CRS/axis order, source dates/vintage, simplified-versus-original lineage, geographic completeness and applicable reuse terms. Verify source shapeIDs against complete original source bodies. Research official primary Japanese boundary/administrative data (for example actual GSI/MLIT or responsible local authority product/service records) and any necessary counterpart/coast/hydrography evidence, with demonstrated finite applicability to fullcandidate/contact geometry. Names or ADM level alone cannot establish geometry/legal role; a locator or national statement cannot become a finite boundary polygon.
3. For each wholecandidate distinguish: compatible-original-source fitness for the existing comparison; positive candidate-scale physical evidence and coverage/NoData/date limits; remaining disagreement/unknown; and concrete source-supported coordinated engineering next action where demonstrated. A new official source is a new vintage, not silently the historical input. Oldmappedland/absent-water pixels do not independently prove dry land. Missing source access or finite legal applicability remains explicit; do not repeat exhausted searches indefinitely or infer cause from a modern replacement. Full political/historical affiliation remains outside scope.
4. Any source query/extraction/count/overlay must consume whole native-item/source bytes honestly, use committed existing shared tools where applicable, retain global raster affine/cell indices and conservative enclosing windows, document full coverage/nodata/cloud/vintage/CRS/identity and reject unsafe paths/changed originals. No independent-sensor claim for two classifiers sharing the same underlying imagery. Sources may remain honestly restoration-only when larger than ordinary file limits; neither URL/hash alone nor a clipped extract is original full-source custody. Opaque inherited source-union references must not be presented as freshly reconstructed originals.
5. Freeze the complete executed code/runtime/import/input closure BEFORE two actual full executions for any new generated comparison. Preserve all superseded/failed attempts, real commands/times/outcomes, every whole output/pointset and meaningful positive/negative controls (wrong full geometry/context/vintage/identity/source coverage, omission/duplicate/foreign/reordered full memberships, original affine/NoData/unsafe bytes and unobserved unknown). Two-run equality of complete outputs is required; final byte readback is not a third generation. Do not recreate existing accepted scientific outputs merely to copy their metadata.
6. Produce one complete per-candidate source-fitness/uncertainty table and full-family reconciliation with clearly supported recommendations or explicit unresolved dispositions. Source-supported engineering repairs must cover affected neighbors and carry release/content revalidation; this initial research packet changes no core geography and cannot certify a whole regional branch or enable historical imports. Bounded initial research may finish with documented unknowns after every promised source-fit assessment is done; parent1202/global geographic repair cannot close with unresolved gaps.
7. Retain every original whole source/citation/vintage/license and existing neighboring packet. Measure the complete actual evidence closure under encoded AND decoded<=33,554,432B/file, aggregate encoded<=268,435,456B and<=512descriptors. Use existing deterministic gzip/whole-record/lossless restoration only. No size waiver, discarded dependencies or new generic framework; if a whole source exceeds ordinary custody bounds, document its honest external restoration and independent source-fit limits rather than disguise an extract as the original.
8. One fresh canonical own claim/managed sparse author checkout after shared complete readiness; distinct substantive exact-head source/method/code/release review bound to current issue/PR bodies; applicable checks and ONE normal serialized queue lifecycle. Verify actual merged whole changed bodies/modes, reconcile original acceptance/direct dependents, release own claim, preserve ALL unique ignored files/modes/literal symlinks outside before exact-token guarded own cleanup. No browser/provider/Neon/live import/publisher message or deployment.

Scope and ownership: only `research/geography/japan-nine-gap-family-source-fitness-20261007/` is owned. Japan regional-review issues #276–#282 own separate regional interior evidence, while #275 retains whole-Japan review obligations. Reuse their retained sources where applicable, but do not take their ownership, change their packets, certify a whole regional branch or enable content imports. #1300 numerical engineering, #1295 Canadian repairs, and #1310 French source-fitness work remain disjoint. Fresh whole-open-issue/PR pagination found no existing dedicated exact-family/component/owned-prefix collision; refresh comment/claim/PR scope and shared readiness before author implementation. Do not claim this while another author job remains active.
